build_ITMHead: build an ITMHead instance with a given hidden size and optional pooler for image-text matching
build_Pooler: build a Pooler module that pools the first token through a linear layer and tanh activation
run_ITMHead_forward: run the forward pass of ITMHead on backbone features to produce image-text matching logits
run_ITMHead_loss: run the loss computation of ITMHead using features and data samples to get matching loss
review_ITMHead_get_loss: review the _get_loss method of ITMHead that unpacks data samples and computes cross entropy loss
